source_document.body:
It’s the very first day of Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days event, and we’ve got a jam-packed edition of Green Deals for you, with the many other deals we couldn’t fit here collected into our Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub here . To start, we’re getting some increased savings from Anker’s SOLIX Fall Prime Day Sale , with options like the 3,840Wh F3800 Portable Power Station down at an exclusive $1,710 , among many others. Likewise, there’s EcoFlow’s Prime Big Deal Days Sale with major savings, including the 3,072Wh DELTA 3 Ultra Plus Power Station down at $1,438 . From there, we have Segway’s e-scooter deals with up to 37% savings starting from $142 , as well as ENGWE’s electric dirt bikes and e-bikes at up to 43% off starting from $599 . There’s also the roundups of EGO Power+ tools, Greenworks tools, Segway’s Navimow i2 series robot lawn mowers at their best prices to date, and so much more waiting for you down below. You can also find yesterday’s hangover deals at the bottom of the page, like the Prime Sales from Velotric and Lectric , or Segway’s e-bikes with up to $2,200 savings, the exclusive Anker eufy security deals , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker SOLIX Fall Prime Day Sale drops 3,840Wh F3800 power station to exclusive $1,710 ($490 off), more from $231
Amazon’s Prime Big Deals Day Sale is in full swing, and Anker’s SOLIX Fall Prime Day Sale (with a separate page for the E10 whole-home backup deals ) is following suit with increased savings up to 43% off, FREE gifts, and our exclusive bonus savings codes. One notable increase is on the 3,840Wh F3800 Portable Power Station for $1,710 shipped , after using the code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, beating Amazon by $90 . Down from $2,200 to $1,980 in the early savings sale, you’re now getting a significant increase up to $490 savings that lands it at the third-lowest price behind falls to $1,700 and $1,599 that occurred during June, giving you the best price we have tracked since late July.
***Note: We have not factored in the bonus 5% off savings into the prices you see below, so be sure to use our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout on orders over $1,000, as well as the code USAFF5 on orders under that threshold, though, again, this latter code doesn’t stack on certain offers.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Top picks from Anker’s SOLIX Fall Prime Day offers:
C2000 Gen 2 (2,048Wh) power station: $900 $850 (Reg. $1,500)
2x S2000 (2,010Wh each) power stations: $1,360 $1,280 (Reg. $2,000)
F3800 (3,840Wh) power station: $1,980 $1,800 (Reg. $2,200)
F3000 (6,144Wh) with expansion battery: $2,200 $2,060 (Reg. $3,200)
F3000 (12,288Wh) with 3x expansion batteries: $3,800 $3,580 (Reg. $6,299)
F3800 Plus (7,680Wh) with expansion battery: $3,999 $3,780 (Reg. $4,299)
2x F3800s (3,840Wh each) with Double Power Hub: $4,159 $3,799 (Reg. $4,890)
2x F3800 Plus (3,840Wh each) with Smart Home Power Kit: $5,440 (Reg. $7,800)
You can browse the entire Anker SOLIX Fall Prime Day Sale lineup in our original coverage here .
Score up to 37% Prime Day savings on Segway e-scooters, like the all-terrain ZT3 Pro down at $800, more from $142
As part of the Amazon Big Deal Days Sale , you can find Segway e-scooters getting up to 37% discounts for the event, including the ZT3 Pro All-Terrain Electric Scooter down at $799.99 shipped , matching the price direct from the brand’s website . While you may see it listed with a $1,300 MSRP directly, it only climbs as high as $1,000 at Amazon, with discounts this year having kept the costs at $850 or more. Instead, for this short-term period, you can score $200 off the going rate (and $500 off the MSRP) putting it back at the price we saw during June’s Prime Day Sale – just $27 above the all-time low that randomly appeared back in late January.
You can browse all Segway’s e-scooter deals in our original coverage here .
EcoFlow’s Fall Prime Day Sale drops 3,072Wh DELTA 3 plus power station to $1,438, more from $279 (Up to 58% off)
EcoFlow has increased savings with its full Prime Big Deal Days power station sale , with up to 58% discounts on its lineup, as well as 2x EcoCredits for members, and the bonus extra savings code EFPDFAFF to be used at checkout. One notable deal worth strongly considering to cover most backup needs is the 3,072Wh DELTA 3 Plus Portable Power Station down at $1,438.30 shipped , after using the above code, beating Amazon by $61 . Down from $2,199 directly, which Amazon rarely sees it climb up to and more often has for as much as $1,599 these days – it’s been keeping up at or within $20 of that rate for most of the time since August began. During this sale you’re getting a combined $131 markdown off the going rate ($761 off the MSRP) for the second-lowest price we have tracked – just $14 above the low from Black Friday 2025.
***Note: The bonus extra savings are not factored into any of the prices you see listed below, so be sure to use the code EFPDFAFF at checkout for the best deals. Some select offers have their own additional savings added in once placed in your cart, and the bonus savings code unfortunately doesn’t stack with these deals, but that is not always the case – so try it with every order just to be sure!
Top picks from EcoFlow’s Prime Big Deal Days Sale:
DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh) with 20W charger: $499 $449 (Reg. $749)
DELTA 3 Max (2,048Wh) power station: $879 $799 (Reg. $1,199)
DELTA 3 Max (2,048Wh) with 500W modular solar panel: $1,399 $1,359 (Reg. $1,998)
DELTA 3 Ultra Plus (3,072Wh) power station: $1,579 $1,499 (Reg. $2,199)
DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) power station: $1,899 $1,799 (Reg. $2,799)
DELTA 3 Ultra Plus (3,072Wh) with 400W solar panel: $1,899 (Reg. $2,699)
DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) with 2x 220W solar panels: $2,399 $2,199 (Reg. $3,289)
DELTA Pro 3 (4,096Wh) power station: $2,799 (Reg. $3,699)
DELTA Pro 3 (4,096Wh) with 400W solar panel: $3,099 (Reg. $3,999)
DELTA Pro Ultra (6,144Wh) power station: $4,199 $3,974 (Reg. $5,799)
DELTA Pro Ultra X (12,288Wh) with Smart Home Panel 3: $10,999 (No initial price cut)
You can browse EcoFlow’s entire Prime Day Sale lineup in our original coverage here .
ENGWE Eagle electric dirt bike with bundle options from $899 ($300 off), or jump on e-bikes starting from $599 (43% off)
As part of the Amazon Big Deal Days sale event, you can find a small collection of ENGWE’s e-bikes and electric dirt bike bundles benefitting from up to 43% savings. Aside from my personal commuting/cruising pick, the M20 3.0 Dual Battery Moped-Style e-bike down at $1,699 shipped from a $2,499 full price (which I went hands-on with in a review ), you can find the newer Eagle Electric Dirt Bike with several different bundle options starting from $899 shipped that would cost you $1,199 or more direct from the brand.
You can browse the full ENGWE Prime Day lineup in our original coverage here .
Segway’s 2026 Navimow i206 AWD and i215 LiDAR robot mowers hit lowest prices during Prime Big Deal Days from $849
As part of Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days event, you can currently find the 2026 Segway Navimow i206 AWD Robot Lawn Mower down at $849 shipped , matching the direct website pricing , while the more advanced Navimow i215 LiDAR Robot Lawn Mower is down at $1,329 shipped , also matching the direct website pricing . These two newer models hit the scene earlier in the year with $999 and $1,599 full price tags, which we’ve seen cut down as low as $849 once before in June and $1,399, last seen in July. The deals here are giving you a second chance all-time low on the i206 AWD model ($150 off) and a new all-time low for the LiDAR model ($270 off).
You can learn all about these two robot mower’s capabilities in our original coverage here .
Rare discount on EGO’s 3,200 PSI electric pressure washer + 2x batteries for $700, more from $80 (Up to 67% off)
Get two of Eve’s HomeKit Aqua smart water controllers with $125 Prime Day savings to a new $175 low
Score up to 48% Fall Prime Day savings on Greenworks electric tools at some of the best prices of the year starting from $54
Fall Prime Day 2026 Green Deals: EVs, power stations, electric tools, smart devices, and much more
Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
Velotric’s Fall Prime Day Sale offers first discount on new Summit 2 mixed-terrain smart e-bike for $1,999, more
Lectric’s Better-Than-Prime Sale cuts XPeak2 off-road e-bike bundle to new $1,299 low, more from $799
Anker’s solar EufyCam S3 Pro 4K 2-cam kit at exclusive $420 (Reg. $550) + other cameras and smart locks from $150
Segway offers $200 extra savings when buying any two of these e-bikes (Up to $2,200 off)
Electrified Weekly – Yozma IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike exclusive $1,699 low ($700 off), early Prime deals on Anker SOLIX power stations, more
FTC: We use income earning auto affiliate links. More.
Stay up to date with the latest content by subscribing to Electrek on Google News . You’re reading Electrek— experts who break news about Tesla , electric vehicles, and green energy , day after day. Be sure to check out our homepage for all the latest news, and follow Electrek on Twitter , Facebook , and LinkedIn to stay in the loop. Don’t know where to start? Check out our YouTube channel for the latest reviews.
